headline: Jet stream at 12-14km (25.1 m/s); GFS underpredicted at 10-12km
findings: Jet stream core identified at 12-14km altitude with measured max wind of 25.1 m/s.
Measured winds peaked at 12-14km (mean 21.7 m/s) and 10-12km (mean 21.0 m/s).
GFS model generally aligned with measurements at 6-10km and 14-20km altitudes.
anomalies: Significant GFS underprediction at 10-12km: Model mean 17.5 m/s vs Measured mean 21.0 m/s (3.5 m/s difference).
GFS underprediction at 12-14km: Model mean 23.8 m/s vs Measured mean 21.7 m/s (2.1 m/s difference), though model max was higher.
GFS overprediction at 18-20km: Model mean 3.3 m/s vs Measured mean 4.3 m/s.
arkivQuery: Wind where flight=hab1-2026-10-31 and dataset=mission-v1, all sources, ordered by altM

headline: Landing error drops to 0.38km at T+100min, enabling recovery drive.
findings: Initial errors were high: 3.84km (hindcast/inflight T+0) and -1km (forecast).
Error stabilized below 2km from T+60min onwards (1.14km to 1.84km).
Minimum error of 0.38km occurred at T+100min (alt=6554m).
anomalies: Forecast T+0min shows negative error (-1km), indicating significant initial inaccuracy.
Error spiked to 4.26km at T+30min despite altitude gain.
Error remained above 1km until T+100min, limiting early recovery precision.
arkivQuery: Prediction where flight=hab1-2026-10-31 and dataset=mission-v1, ordered by fromFlightS
